title: •Wookiee Strangle
caption: •Wookiee Strangle (V)
game_text: During your move phase, target your Wookiee and opponent’s character present with it. Both players draw destiny. Add target’s defense value and power. Subtract target’s destiny number. Opponent’s character lost if your total destiny +2 > opponent’s total destiny.
lore: Wookiees have been known to dislocate more than just arms.
